issue.title: docs-check strict build: capture.md links task-dependencies §12.24 with a double-hyphen anchor that does not exist
issue.description:
## What fails

`docs/capture.md:8214` (bob-cli master 270b5b23) links
`task-dependencies.md#1224-js--jump-successor-contract-and-vectors`. The target heading
`### 12.24 JS — jump successor contract and vectors` (`docs/task-dependencies.md:3806`)
slugs to `1224-js-jump-successor-contract-and-vectors` under the site's Python-Markdown
`toc` slugify (the em dash is dropped and the surrounding spaces collapse to ONE hyphen).
Sibling em-dash links already use the single-hyphen form and resolve, e.g.
`#1217-lp-leaf-vectors` and `#1221-np-note-pull-vectors`.

The strict Zensical build reports `anchor does not exist` at `capture.md:8220:56` (the
assembled page) and aborts with `RuntimeError: Aborted because --strict flag is set`, so
`npm run docs:check` in bob-plugins (which builds bob-cli docs from its cached checkout at
532df82) exits 1 with `docs-check: FAILED (strict Zensical build, exit 1)`. Lint and
generated-drift stages pass; this is the only strict-build warning.

## Root cause and fix

Introduced by 853246f0 `feat(capture): add successor jump offer contract`
(SASE_BEAD bob-cli-oe.1, epic bob-cli-oe now closed). Replace `--` with `-` in that one
anchor: `task-dependencies.md#1224-js-jump-successor-contract-and-vectors`. Then run
`just docs-check` (bob-cli) to confirm the strict build passes.

## Found while

Repairing the bob-plugins rebase of d87c5f13 (nav [[ completion in modal prompts); the
bob-plugins docs gate failed only on this bob-cli page.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static link check: the anchor slug differs from the heading's generated slug, reproduced on every run; the cached docs checkout at 532df82 and bob-cli master 270b5b23 both carry the link.

issue.creation_reason: The strict Zensical build aborts on this broken anchor, so every bob-plugins and bob-cli docs:check fails until the one-character fix lands.
